findings.title: Frontier dual-air witness 50036056 is reproduced by the original game under race-relative alignment: a one-frame simultaneous hop
source_artifacts: signed census research/qa-cumulative-ledger frontier_exact_coverage tokens 79968377c3bf214b60c95a12 (2580) and fb53e5eaddfbcae645a046f6 (3420)
findings.observation: Original frames 2577-2579 (native-equivalent 2579-2581): P2 air 1 -> 2 -> 0, P1 air 0 -> 1 -> 0, y_speed 19/38 for one frame. The original's normalized fingerprint equals the native census token at both 2580 and 3420.
findings.uncertainty: Quantized census fields only; $0545/$0547 semantics remain provisional; the frontier binary's entry lag is inferred (RF-003), not directly measured.
findings.resolving_experiment: None needed for parity. Optional: original writer trace of $0545/$0547 at original 2577-2579 to name the hop mechanism.
findings.consequence: Not a discrepancy. Removes the only frontier dual-air lead from the QA-01 queue; the 120-frame sampler caught a one-frame coincidence, not sustained flight.
findings.resolution: Original/native agree at the race-relative-equivalent frame (2026-10-14 local cross-check).

findings.title: Same-absolute-host paired comparison with unshifted input is confounded by race-entry phase
source_artifacts: .github/workflows/two-player-reference.yml step 'QA-01 paired source dual-air seed 50036056' (run 38509912672, artifact qa01-dual-air-paired-50036056)
findings.observation: With identical absolute-frame input the original sees P1 air 0 at host 2580 while the native frontier case had both nonzero; at L=0 the original's 2580 token is absent from the census. The difference is the entry phase, not gameplay.
findings.uncertainty: The CI report itself could not be fetched from this session (artifact blob egress blocked); its original side is reproduced locally with the same ROM, core and input.
findings.resolving_experiment: QA-01: read raw_both_air_at_2580 from run 38509912672 as phase-confounded; for any future same-input paired replay apply a measured race-relative input shift as the ordinary 2P regression already does.
findings.consequence: Prevents a false original/native dual-air discrepancy from entering the QA-01 queue.

findings.title: Frontier Modern native enters the ordinary 2P race 2 host frames after Snes9x (generic native: 1)
source_artifacts: calibration: the seed-independent 1740 token matches at L=0 and L=2 only
exploration set: first 10 cases of run 38506108109 agree at 2580 and 3420 for L=2 (10/10), L=0 (9/10), L=1 (0/10)
findings.observation: Consistent with Baldosa's documented +1/+2 event-entry lags (QA01-THREE-EVENT-TERMINAL-TIMING-20261010.md).
findings.uncertainty: Inferred from fingerprint agreement, not from a dense native entry probe on executable 28501fa3...; lag 2 and 4 share scheduler parity.
findings.resolving_experiment: One dense 1128-1140 dump run of the preserved frontier executable (no new build); expect first inRace=1/race_tick=1 at 1136.
findings.consequence: Any original/native replay of frontier input must shift post-entry input by -2 and compare native F with original F-2.

findings.title: Original-emulator cross-check of the frontier census population
findings.uncertainty: Quantized fields (x//64, y//32, v//64, rotation//16) can hide sub-bin differences; agreement is not strict equality.
findings.resolving_experiment: Complete the population; any coarse_divergence seed becomes its own original/native discrepancy candidate with a dense bisect.
findings.consequence: Converts 10,400 native-only cases into original/native comparisons without a single new native process.

source_artifacts: ordinary 2P regression asserts screen1 P2 (0x70,0x70) and screen2 P1 (0x30,0x30) at $1501-$150E on both runtimes
findings.uncertainty: Sentinel incidence in random frontier trajectories is measured on the original side only so far.
findings.resolving_experiment: QA-08: if a culling/visibility question needs a population, request a frontier observer change replacing $121B/$121D with the sentinel predicate (100-case validation run).
findings.consequence: Stops further volume aimed at a dead register; gives QA-08 a named, source-qualified observer.
